text: I have received your test results; however, your current symptoms of postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness are more indicative of an infection like endometritis rather than iron deficiency anemia. speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum endometritis with possible urinary tract involvement.
